pages.title: A street in Chicago · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a bright Saturday morning in Chicago. Ana meets her friend Ida near the river. The street is closed to cars today. Families are already waiting on the sidewalk. A small band is warming up nearby. The big parade begins soon.

“The parade starts at ten, and it ends at noon. Do you have a good place?” says Ida. “Not yet. Does the route go along the river, or does it turn at the park?” says Ana. “It goes along the river and turns at the bridge. The parade is held every year in March.” says Ida.
